ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 11

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 22

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

7. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

11. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

13. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 50
   C. 100
   D. 10

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 30

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

17. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 13
   C. 10
   D. 4

18. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

22. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

23. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: 81
